title: fix-plan
description: Structural contract for .guide/bug-rounds/round-N/fix-plan.json (brief 08 / P1b). Deliberately MINIMAL: it pins only the fields setBugRoundFixPlan and the fix loop ACTUALLY read (`fixes` array; each fix's integer `n`, the identifier every commit/marker/completion record keys off). Everything else a guide may emit (title, goal, severity, files_likely, files, acceptance_criteria) is optional and additive — an over-strict schema would false-positive on valid plans, so those stay unconstrained beyond their type when present.

n.description: The fix identifier. Every consumer keys off this (fix-r{round}-{n} commit names, validation-failed markers, recordFixCompletion, `f.n === fix.n` lookups) — a non-integer or missing n breaks the fix loop, so this is the one strictly-required per-fix field.
